edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — he is catchable only while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W gold card is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge (W): 20s at rank 1, 12s max — his only escape; he is catchable only in that window, so count it out. - Bouncing Bomb (Q): 6s early — the gap after a whiffed bomb is your walk-up. - Mega Inferno Bomb: 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Hold yellow until he steps up to bomb — his Q runs 6s early, so the punish window after a whiff comes around constantly.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: Ziggs matches your shove but never your Gate — every wave you sit mid past 6 is a bot-lane play you declined; he cannot follow Destiny.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-shoved crash timed to your Destiny cooldown — TF waves are appointments; the map is the actual client. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with gold card down — the global champion dying locally is the worst trade in League. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.
edits.after: Best wave: a Q-shoved crash timed to your Destiny cooldown — TF waves are appointments; the map is the actual client. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with gold card down — the global champion dying locally is the worst trade in League. And watch your own turret below half health — his Satchel Charge executes vulnerable towers the moment you roam.

edits.before: W online: the gold card re-prices his every step-up. Lock yellow when he walks forward and the lane behaves.
edits.after: W online: gold card re-prices his steps, and Wild Cards shove starts the roam threat his immobility can't answer.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: Full kit: it's a read on his Satchel — force it out and he's exposed; misplay the spacing and you eat full bombs.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Even farming levels — Q the wave, dodge the bomb line, and stay off Hexplosive Minefield in every trade.

edits.before: Destiny online — THE level in this lane. Every shove is now a bot-lane death sentence with a 130-second timer.
edits.after: Destiny online — the answer to an immobile mage. Shove and Gate; every roam he can't follow is a won trade.

edits.before: Lich Bane spike: gold card chunks half bars. The lane still isn't the point — the map pays your salary.
edits.after: Lich Bane spike: gold card chunks half bars and your roam cadence keeps a pinned Ziggs farming reactively.
